description: This file is a TypeScript source file that implements a command-line interface (CLI) tool for updating AOSP dictionaries. It includes functions for downloading, decompressing, reading YAML mappings, comparing archive files, and executing the update process with command-line options.

classes.name: TextFileDiff
classes.description: A class imported from './differ.js' used for diffing text files.

methods.name: downloadFileToTemp
methods.description: Downloads a file from a URL to a temporary location.

methods.name: decompressTarGz
methods.description: Decompresses a .tar.gz archive to a temporary directory.

methods.name: decompressGz
methods.description: Decompresses a .gz file to a temporary location.

methods.name: readYamlToDictionary
methods.description: Reads a YAML file and parses it into a dictionary with a 'mapping' array.

methods.name: compareArchives
methods.description: Decompresses two archive files and compares their contents, returning a list of differences.
